title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP07-ci-auth — authorizations for the CI cost controls and the verified change scope
goal: Add the change-trusted-base and weaken-policy authorizations that the CP07-ci change PR will consume and record D28, without changing any trusted component or registered policy.
acceptanceCriteria: A change-trusted-base record covers tcb.activation.ci, tcb.engine.trusted-base and tcb.validation.package-tests, with a parity contract that states the only authorized verdict difference, and a weaken-policy record covers ci/jobs.json and contracts/change-scope.schema.json.

D28 records the measured per-run cost, the cost controls and the base-owned change scope, and states that the 13 required check names, the job DAG, the trigger semantics and the ruleset stay unchanged; Plan 06 section 17 and the plan pair index both list it.
No trusted component or registered policy changes, nothing is deleted, and all 13 required checks pass.
